probeSource: ()=>{const all=[...document.querySelectorAll('body *')];const clips=all.filter(e=>e.getClientRects().length&&!e.closest('script,style,noscript,.skip')).map(e=>({e,s:getComputedStyle(e),r:e.getBoundingClientRect()})).filter(x=>['hidden','clip'].includes(x.s.overflowX)||['hidden','clip'].includes(x.s.overflowY));let textNodes=0,textRects=0;const outside=[],clipped=[];for(const e of all){if(e.closest('script,style,noscript,.skip,details:not([open]) .rule-body'))continue;for(const n of e.childNodes){if(n.nodeType!==3||!n.textContent.trim())continue;const range=document.createRange();range.selectNodeContents(n);const rects=[...range.getClientRects()].filter(r=>r.width&&r.height);if(!rects.length)continue;textNodes++;for(const r of rects){textRects++;if(r.left<-.75||r.right>document.documentElement.clientWidth+.75)outside.push({text:n.textContent.trim().slice(0,60),left:r.left,right:r.right});for(const p of clips){if(!p.e.contains(n))continue;if((['hidden','clip'].includes(p.s.overflowX)&&(r.left<p.r.left-1||r.right>p.r.right+1))||(['hidden','clip'].includes(p.s.overflowY)&&(r.top<p.r.top-1||r.bottom>p.r.bottom+1)))clipped.push({text:n.textContent.trim().slice(0,60),parent:p.e.tagName});}}}}const visible=e=>e.getClientRects().length&&getComputedStyle(e).visibility!=='hidden';return{url:location.href,width:innerWidth,height:innerHeight,dpr:devicePixelRatio,scrollWidth:document.documentElement.scrollWidth,clientWidth:document.documentElement.clientWidth,textNodes,textRects,outside,clipped,controls:[...document.querySelectorAll('header a,.filter,.reset,.copy-button,input[type=search],details.rule summary')].filter(visible).map(e=>({label:e.textContent.trim().slice(0,65)||e.id,width:e.getBoundingClientRect().width,height:e.getBoundingClientRect().height})),headerPosition:getComputedStyle(document.querySelector('header')).position,balanced:[...document.querySelectorAll('h1,h2,h3,p')].filter(e=>getComputedStyle(e).textWrapStyle==='balance').length,rules:document.querySelectorAll('details.rule').length};}
